sentences.text:
----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Jayram Saran.
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Solanki, Pp.
 Mr. Vinod Kumar Sharma
 Mr. Dilip Sharma.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur
Order 19/10/2023

The instant misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the accused-petitioner for quashing of FIR No.212/2023, registered at P.S. Mandore, Distt. Jodhpur City East for offence under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 474, 120-B of IPC.
After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the material available on record, this Court is not inclined to quash the FIR.

However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to file a representation before the Commissioner of Police, Jodhpur and the Investigating Officer within a period of two weeks from today, who shall consider all the facts as well as contentions raised in the [2023:RJ-JD:36133] (2 of 2)
[CRLMP-4658/2023] representation and complete the investigation strictly in accordance with law.
For a period of four weeks from today, the petitioner shall not be arrested in FIR No.212/2023 registered at P.S. Mandore, Distt. Jodhpur City East.
